title: Flash
tagline: Built a decentralized flash loan arbitrage bot using modified warden-agent-kit. Monitors and executes cross-chain arbitrage opportunities between Optimism and Sepolia, maximizing DeFi profits through automated trading
description:
Our project revolutionizes flash loan arbitrage by leveraging the warden-agent-kit framework with custom modifications. The system continuously monitors price discrepancies across Optimism and Sepolia networks, automatically executing profitable arbitrage opportunities using flash loans.
The bot implements sophisticated price monitoring algorithms to identify profitable trading paths, factors in gas costs and network conditions, and executes trades with minimal latency. By utilizing flash loans, the system can execute large-volume trades without requiring significant capital upfront, maximizing potential returns while minimizing risk.
how_its_made:
Modified warden-agent-kit node modules to support flash loan functionality
Custom smart contracts deployed on both Optimism and Sepolia networks
Node.js backend for monitoring and execution logic
Automated arbitrage detection algorithms
Smart Contract Layer: Custom flash loan contracts on both networks that handle borrowing and repayment
Monitoring Layer: Price feed aggregators that track asset prices across multiple DEXs
Execution Layer: High-performance trade execution system with failsafes
Analytics Layer: Real-time profitability calculation and risk assessment
